description: Business metric definitions and rules for the GlobalTrade Analytics BI agent. Synthetic reference only.
business_rules: All queries are read-only. Never generate INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, ALTER, TRUNCATE, MERGE, CREATE, or GRANT.
Revenue is stored net of discount in FACT_SALES.revenue.
Join facts to dimensions on surrogate keys (date_id, customer_id, product_id, region_id).
Always add a LIMIT to exploratory row-level queries unless an aggregate is requested.
Time comparisons use DIM_DATE.year / quarter / month.

gross_margin_pct.definition: Gross margin as a percentage of net revenue.

yoy_growth.definition: Year-over-year revenue growth percent comparing a period to the same period one year earlier.

average_discount.definition: Mean discount fraction applied across sales lines.

forecast_attainment.definition: Actual revenue divided by forecasted revenue.

on_time_delivery_rate.definition: Share of shipments delivered on time.
on_time_delivery_rate.formula: AVG(CASE WHEN on_time_flag THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100
